name: TrueWood Natural Oak Slats, Grey Felt
summary: Solid rubberwood slats wrapped in real white oak veneer on the front and both edges, in a natural oak finish with grey acoustic felt behind the slats.

texture.note: No manufacturer spec sheet was published; photos suggest 7 slats per recorded 11.8 in panel, with estimated 1.18 in faces, 0.506 in grey-felt gaps and 1.686 in pitch, lightly rounded edges, and recorded 0.75 in total thickness (0.30 in felt / 0.45 in wood relief estimated). Tile is 7 pitches wide by 23.6 in tall; natural oak tones and grey felt were sampled from the main listing photo, with gallery photos used only for structure.
